transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I suppose... my daughter wanted me to come. I just don't have the push I used to. I used to go to choir, do my quilting, visit folks... but I just sit at home now. The TV's on low. I know people are expecting me, but... I just don't go.
Do you still enjoy the activities you used to do, like quilting and choir?
I don't know. Like I was saying... I just don't have the push for it anymore. Even knowing they're expecting me at choir, I just... I'd rather just stay sitting with the TV.
Do you still find pleasure in the things you used to enjoy?
I couldn't really say. I just... I don't feel much of anything about it either way. It's just easier to sit.
Do you ever think about hurting yourself?
No... I don't have thoughts like that. I just sit.
Do you feel tired most of the time?
Not really. I don't feel sleepy or anything like that. I just... I don't know. I just stay in my chair.
How long have you been feeling this way, without the push to do things?
I suppose... it's been a while now. Maybe since I left my job at the school office. That was... a little over two years ago, I think. It just sort of built up since then.
Do you often think that you're worthless or that you've let others down?
No... I don't think so. I don't really have thoughts like that. I just... keep to myself mostly.
Do you find yourself moving more slowly than you used to?
No... I don't think so. I just... don't get up much.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight recently?
No... I don't think so. My clothes still fit about the same, I guess. I haven't really paid much attention to it.
Do you feel sad most of the time?
Not really, no. I wouldn't say I'm sad. I just... sit quietly most days.
Do you ever find any activities or things that give you pleasure?
I don't know... not really. I just... pass the time, I guess.
Are there any small things that you still enjoy, like a favorite food or a beautiful sunset?
No... not really. Food is just food, I guess. I just eat what's there. I don't really notice things like the sky much.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure from activities that would normally be enjoyable?
I suppose so... I just don't have the push I used to. For... things like choir, or quilting. I know folks expect me to visit, but... I mostly just sit at home now. Just have the TV on low.
Do you feel like you're moving or reacting more slowly than other people around you?
I don't think so... I haven't really noticed. I'm mostly just by myself, so... I wouldn't really know how I am compared to anyone else.
Have you noticed any change in your weight over the past few months?
No... I don't think so. My clothes fit about the same, I guess. I haven't really been paying attention to it.
Do you feel like you're moving or doing things more slowly than you used to?
I don't think so. I don't really do much anyway, so... it's hard to tell. Just getting up to make tea or something... it feels about the same, I guess.
Do you think you've lost interest in activities you used to enjoy?

I suppose... I just don't really have the push I used to. For things like choir, or... quilting. Or visiting folks. I mostly just sit at home now. Just have the TV on low... even though I know people are expecting me. I just... don't go.
Would you say this lack of push to do things is something that happens nearly every day?
I guess so... yeah. Most days. Just... don't feel like doing much.
Would you say that your lack of interest in activities and feeling of not having the push to do things is mild, moderate, or severe?
I don't really know. I guess... maybe mild, I suppose. I'm not sure. It's just... how it is.
Would you say that most days you have no interest at all in doing things you used to enjoy?
I suppose... like I was saying before. I just don't have the push for the choir or the quilting anymore. Most days I just sit there with the TV on. I just... don't really care to do 'em.
